natural_language_summary: Air quality in Delhi is currently unhealthy for sensitive groups, with an AQI of 280 (Poor). Conditions are worsening — the 24-hour forecast indicates AQI may rise to 320 (model confidence: 82%). The primary driver appears to be crop burning, compounded by Very high PM2.5 (220.0 µg/m³), Weak winds (2.1 m/s), which are limiting pollution dispersion. The dominant pollutant is PM10, which poses the greatest health risk under current conditions. It is advised to wear n95 mask outdoors.
